content: tailwind-canonicalize is a production-grade CLI and library that rewrites Tailwind utility classes into their theme-canonical form — only when the result is provably identical . It is not a linter and not a general formatter. It sits beside Biome, ESLint, Oxlint, and Prettier without fighting them. Three transformation categories | Category | What | Safety | |----------|------|--------| | Canonical class | Arbitrary values → theme tokens | Automatic when exact | | Tailwind migration | e.g. bg-gradient-to-br → bg-linear-to-br | Versioned registry | | Semantic tokens | bg-white → bg-background | Analyze + approved manifest only | Goals Zero false positives Unknown values, calc(), var(), and multi-match ambiguity are never rewritten. Coverage is secondary to safety. Theme-driven Loads project @theme (v4) or tailwind.config. (v3). Never hardcodes your design system. Format-preserving Uses MagicString and a real AST (oxc). Comments, multiline class strings, and non-class code stay intact. Ecosystem-friendly First-class integration guides for Biome, ESLint, Oxlint, Prettier, and CI. Next steps - Installation - CLI reference - Interactive examples - Safety contract - Semantic tokens

content: Is this a linter? No. It rewrites Tailwind utilities when equivalence is proven. Use Biome/ESLint/Oxlint for lint. Will it break my design? Only rewrites that match your theme (or approved token map) apply. Ambiguous cases are left alone. Does it sort classes? No. Use prettier-plugin-tailwindcss or eslint-plugin-tailwindcss for ordering. Can it invent semantic tokens automatically? Analyze proposes; apply requires an approved manifest. Default mode never auto-applies semantics. v3 and v4? v4 @theme first. v3 tailwind.config. is loaded when no CSS theme is found. Migrations cover common v3→v4 renames. Monorepo? Yes — pass package paths, use --workers, and per-package scripts. Theme discovery uses project CSS/config near cwd.
title: FAQ

content: What rewrites Spacing, sizing, radius, font size, keywords, fractions — with variants and ! preserved. How equivalence works 1. Parse utility structure 2. Resolve active theme (@theme or defaults) 3. Normalize lengths (px ↔ rem at root 16) 4. Match scale keys 5. Require a single safe candidate Optional: --strict-compile uses Tailwind’s compile() API when installed.

content: Semantic replacements are architectural , not purely canonical. The same bg-amber-200 may mean warning, selection, or decoration — so inference never auto-writes. Phase 1 — Analyze No source edits. Outputs proposals, conflicts, duplicate token reports, cycles. Phase 2 — Apply Only explicit mappings, pairs, and recipes in the manifest. Dark pairs when the pair is approved and dual-theme values exist. Theme CSS Generates Tailwind v4 @theme / @theme inline with optional :root + .dark app variables. Prefers aliasing existing --warning-subtle over inventing duplicates.

title: Prettier

content: Contract A rewrite is applied only when exactly one theme candidate matches after value normalization (or a registered migration / approved mapping applies). | Situation | Behavior | |-----------|----------| | 0 candidates | Leave untouched | | 1 candidate | Rewrite | | \ 1 candidates | Leave untouched (unless documented preference, e.g. 1/2 over 2/4) | | calc / var / min / max / clamp | Never | | Arbitrary properties [mask-image:…] | Never | | Semantic palette → token | Never without approved manifest | Modes | Mode | Flag | Applies | |------|------|---------| | Safe | --safe (default) | Exact canonical + safe migrations + approved tokens + dups | | Review | --review | Report/diff only | | Aggressive | --aggressive | Explicit; may include review migrations / high-confidence inference | Idempotence Unsafe counter CLI always reports unsafe: 0 — the engine refuses ambiguous rewrites rather than guessing.
description: Zero false positives — the core product contract.
title: Safety

content: No rewrites happen - Confirm classes are in supported positions (className, clsx, cn, …) - Check theme load (--verbose or JSON themeSource) - Values like w-[13px] have no scale match — intentional CI fails with exit 1 Cache seems stale Delete .tailwind-canonicalize-cache.json or change options (options hash invalidates). Conflicts with Biome/Prettier Run canonicalize then format. Don’t enable two tools that rewrite the same class strings. Semantic tokens not applied Ensure tokens apply + manifest path, or config tokens.enabled + manifest. Safe mode never invents mappings.
